Go down through the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, north of Thais, cross poison fields and the minotaur city of Mintwallin to a room with Cyclops. Pull the switch (you get trapped with the cyclopes), take the reward and leave through a hole. You receive a {item:Small Diamond}, two {item:Strong Health Potion|Strong Health Potions}, a {item:Hatchet}, a {item:Chain Helmet} and a {item:Chain Armor}.
Recommended: {wiki:Antidote}, {item:Antidote Rune} or {wiki:Destroy Field} for the {item:Poison Field|poison fields}
Bring health potions: the minotaur room and the Cyclops room can be dangerous for low levels.
When you pull the switch you are locked in with the Cyclops: clear the room beforehand or get ready to fight them.
1. Going down through the Ancient Temple
Leave **Thais** through the **north** door: the {wiki:Ancient Temple} is just northwest of that door ({coord:32356,32171,7}). Enter the temple.
On the way there are {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}, a few {creature:Orc|Orcs} and possibly a {creature:Fire Devil} lured by someone.
Going down two floors and heading north
Go down **two floors** and head as far **north** as you can.
Go down to the floor with the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}. Follow the path in the picture **east** and then **south**, and go down the staircase.
Path on the Rotworm floor to the stairs
On this floor there are lots of {item:Poison Field|poison fields}. You can run through them and then heal with an antidote, or use {wiki:Destroy Field} to clear a path. Then go down one more floor.

Follow the path in the picture **east** and **north**. Beware of the {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}. Go down through the hole marked with a circle on the map. Down there you will find a few {creature:Cyclops}.
Follow the whole path **north** and go down one floor.
Path north to the way down

This room has lots of {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}, {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers}, a {creature:Minotaur Mage} and a {creature:Minotaur Guard}. Fight your way to the **south** of the room and go up one floor.
Minotaur room and the climb to the south
You enter the room through the **northwest** corner (1 on the map). Follow the passage until you find the switch.
Reward room: (1) entrance, (2) switch, (3) reward, (4) exit
Pull the switch (2). The wall moves and you are basically trapped with the {creature:Cyclops}.
After you pull the switch you are locked in with the Cyclops: you can only leave through the hole to the north.
{item:Small Diamond}, 2 {item:Strong Health Potion|Strong Health Potions}, {item:Hatchet}, {item:Chain Helmet} and {item:Chain Armor}
To leave, go to the hole at the end of the passage to the **north** (4). It is a one-way drop: it takes you back to the minotaur room.

From the minotaur room, go back the same way you came: climb the staircase you used to come down to this room, follow the whole path **south** to the {creature:Cyclops} hole and use the {item:Rope} to climb up. Then retrace the path in the picture in reverse (**south** and **west**), cross the {item:Poison Field|poison fields} again, climb the staircase to the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} floor and from there go up the two floors to the {wiki:Ancient Temple}. You come out north of Thais ({coord:32356,32171,7}).
The same path, now in reverse (from the hole back to the staircase)
Ancient Temple exit, north of Thais
Without a {item:Rope} you cannot climb back up through the Cyclops hole.
If the wall has already been moved and you cannot open the door, wait for the next {wiki:Floor Reset} or server save, or use the {item:Key 3667} to unlock the door.
